description: A bearded man in a black academic gown and flat black cap stands behind a dark wooden pulpit in a dim, vaulted stone hall, raising one fist as if preaching. Candles and an oil lamp light the pulpit, and a crowd of men in dark caps and clothing looks up at him from below and the sides. The stone arches, column, lancet window and candelabra suggest a 16th-century-style interior. There are no letters, numbers or signature, and the painting runs edge to edge with no frame. A small white sparkle logo sits in the bottom-right corner, which is cropped and acceptable.
